scenes.title: A Devout Businesswoman in Philippi
scenes.english_text: Lydia was a godly woman from the city of Thyatira who lived in Philippi. She was a successful businesswoman who sold fine purple cloth, a valuable fabric worn by kings and wealthy people. Though she was busy with her business, Lydia loved God deeply and gathered with other women outside the city gate to pray by the river every Sabbath.
scenes.tetum_translation: Lídia ne'e feto laran-luak ho fiar metin husi sidade Tiatira ne'ebé hela iha Filipos. Nia ne'e feto negosianu ne'ebé susesu fa'an hena roxo (purple) ne'ebé folin karu no uza husi liurai ho ema riku sira. Maski nia okupadu ho nia negósiu, Lídia ama Maromak husi laran no halibur hamutuk ho feto seluk iha li'ur sidade nian atu harohan iha mota ninin iha loron Sábadu hotu.
scenes.scene_summary: Lydia, a seller of purple cloth in Philippi, faithfully worships God and gathers for prayer by the river.

scenes.title: Listening to Paul by the River
scenes.english_text: One Sabbath day, the apostle Paul and his companions Silas, Timothy, and Luke arrived at the riverside prayer gathering. Paul sat down with the women and warmly shared the Good News about Jesus Christ. Lydia listened attentively to every word Paul spoke, desiring to know more about the Savior.
scenes.tetum_translation: Iha loron Sábadu ida, apóstolu Paulu no nia maluk sira hanesan Sillas, Timóteo, no Lucas to'o iha fatin harohan mota ninin nian. Paulu tuur hamutuk ho feto sira no fahe ho laran-manas Linguagem Di'ak kona-ba Jesus Kristu. Lídia rona ho atensaun boot ba dalan hotu ne'ebé Paulu ko'alia, ho hakarak boot atu hatene liu tan kona-ba Salvadór.
scenes.scene_summary: Paul shares the Gospel of Jesus Christ with Lydia and the women gathered at the river.
scenes.nano_banana_prompt: Nano Banana illustration style, a graceful woman named Lydia sitting attentively among a group of women by a serene riverbank, listening earnestly to Paul who is speaking warmly under green trees. Whimsical fairytale picture book watercolor texture, rich vibrant pastel colors, no text, 4:3 aspect ratio.

scenes.title: The Lord Opens Her Heart
scenes.english_text: As Paul spoke, the Lord gently opened Lydia's heart to accept the gospel message. She believed in Jesus with joy and gave her life to God. Soon after, Lydia and all the members of her household were baptized in the river as a public confession of their new faith in Christ.
scenes.tetum_translation: Bainhira Paulu ko'alia, Na'i loke Lídia nia laran ho mamar atu simu lia-menon lia-mós evanjeillu nian. Nia fiar iha Jesus ho haksolok boot no fó nia moris ba Maromak. Sedu tan, Lídia no nia umakain tomak hetan batizmu iha mota laran nu'udar sasin nakloke kona-ba sira-nia fiar foun iha Kristu.
scenes.scene_summary: God opens Lydia's heart to believe, and she and her entire household are baptized.
scenes.nano_banana_prompt: Nano Banana illustration style, a joyful woman named Lydia being baptized in a clear river with water glistening in soft sunlight, as Apostle Paul prays over her with warm smiles around. Whimsical fairytale picture book watercolor texture, rich vibrant pastel colors, no text, 4:3 aspect ratio.

scenes.title: Opening Her Home to the Apostles
scenes.english_text: Filled with gratitude and love, Lydia urged Paul and his missionary team, saying, 'If you consider me a true believer in the Lord, come and stay at my home.' With genuine hospitality and persistence, she welcomed them into her house, providing them with food, rest, and encouragement.
scenes.tetum_translation: Nakeno ho agradesimentu no domin, Lídia husu ho laran-manas ba Paulu no nia ekipa misionáriu, dehan, 'Se imi haree ha'u nu'udar ema fiar-na'in ne'ebé lialoos ba Na'i, mai no hela iha ha'u-nia uma.' Ho laran-luak no laran-di'ak, nia simu sira iha nia uma, hodi fó hahán, deskansa, no ho ksolok brani ba sira.
scenes.scene_summary: Lydia generously welcomes Paul and the missionaries into her home, offering hospitality.
scenes.nano_banana_prompt: Nano Banana illustration style, a welcoming woman named Lydia inviting Apostle Paul and his friends into her cozy stone home with warm lanterns and a set table. Whimsical fairytale picture book watercolor texture, rich vibrant pastel colors, no text, 4:3 aspect ratio.

scenes.title: A Pillar of Support for the Philippian Church
scenes.english_text: Lydia's home became the very first house church in Europe! Even after Paul and Silas were released from prison, they visited Lydia's home to encourage the believers before departing. Lydia continued to use her business, home, and resources faithfully to support the growing church and spread God's love.
scenes.tetum_translation: Lídia nia uma sai fali uma-kreda da'et uluk iha Europa! Maski bainhira Paulu no Sillas sai husi komarka, sira vizita Lídia nia uma atu fó ksolok brani ba ema fiar-na'in sira antes sira ba. Lídia kontinua uza nia negósiu, uma, no rikusoin ho laran-metin atu apoia kreda ne'ebé da'et no habelar Maromak nia domin.
scenes.scene_summary: Lydia's home becomes the first European house church, serving as a stronghold of hospitality and fellowship.

Whimsical fairytale picture book watercolor texture, rich vibrant pastel colors, no text, 4:3 aspect ratio.

reflection.core_lesson_en: Lydia teaches us to open our hearts to God's message and use our homes, resources, and gifts generously to bless others and support God's work.
reflection.core_lesson_tet: Lídia hanorin ita atu loke ita-nia laran ba Maromak nia lia-menon no uza ita-nia uma, rikusoin, no talentu ho laran-luak atu haraik bensaun ba ema seluk no apoia Maromak nia servisu.
reflection.discussion_question_en: How can you use your time, home, or small gifts to welcome others and show God's warmth and love to people around you?
reflection.discussion_question_tet: Oinsá ó bele uza ó-nia tempu, uma, ka talentu ki'ik sira atu simu ema seluk no hatudu Maromak nia manas no domin ba ema iha ó-nia sorin?
